decisions.why: mod3d on software GL renders ~1 frame/s, which starves the page's timers (1-2 s gaps, 0 usable samples in an 800 ms window); Metal gives 60 fps and 10 Hz sampling. Rejected: AudioWorklet meter (addModule never resolves under Playwright), shrinking the mod3d viewport (blurry clip, still 250 ms gaps).

decisions.decision: Measuring AudioContexts (fake mic and receiver) use sinkId {type:'none'}; no extra hidden audio sink in the hook
decisions.why: Headless Chromium plays out nothing (inbound totalSamplesReceived 0, RMS 0) once mod3d holds 12 remote streams plus real outputs (11 or fewer worked); sinkId none fixes it. Rejected: unmuting the product's muted elements, closing the product ctx (no effect).

decisions.decision: Check 'AC-5 toVote accepted, MORNING left (day 1: VOTE_RESULT)' accepts any phase except MORNING
decisions.why: Engine skips the vote on day 1 and goes to VOTE_RESULT, so the contract's 'phase VOTE' can never hold in MORNING day 1; the cut-off checks are unchanged.

decisions.decision: Marker check also reads a MutationObserver event log on mod3d desks and allows 300 ms after the slot
decisions.why: Marker set by the product's own timer is stamped when it changes, independent of sampler cadence; rule (marker at least once per slot) unchanged.

decisions.decision: Sampler writes per-stream blocks {t,rms,bin} and mixBlocks {t,rms,tone[12]} (100 ms) instead of per-tick 'per' maps; seat stats bucket by 100 ms and take the max over sids of a seat
decisions.why: Same measurements and thresholds as contract; simpler windowing, and tolerates two pcs sharing a sid after a reconnect.

decisions.decision: After unsilence, wait 1500 ms (not 500 ms) after P05 out===12 before the replay slot
decisions.why: Gives the receivers' new inbound pcs time to connect; thresholds untouched (all constants kept at contract values).

decisions.decision: A/V alignment checked: toVote scene change within ~0.5 s, slot-1 audio at 1.2 s, P05 marker visible in the P05 slot frame
decisions.why: Contract [verify] item; offsets are recorded in report.json clip.
